successCriteria.description: Create src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts with: LeaveRequestStatus enum (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED), LeaveType interface (id, code, name, description, isPaid, requiresDocumentation, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt), LeavePolicy interface (id, policyName, leaveTypeId, entitlementDays, accrualRate, maxCarryoverDays, minRequestDays, maxConsecutiveDays, requiresDocumentation, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt), LeaveRequest interface (id, employeeId, leaveTypeId, startDate, endDate, reason, status: LeaveRequestStatus, approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason, createdAt, updatedAt), CreateLeaveRequestDto, and UpdateLeaveRequestStatusDto.

Ensure src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts exists with ILeaveRequestRepository interface extending IBaseRepository<LeaveRequest> and KnexLeaveRepository class extending BaseKnexRepository<LeaveRequest>, using table name 'leave_requests'. The interface must include findByEmployeeId, findByStatus, findOverlapping, and updateStatus methods matching the existing implementation.

Create tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.repository.test.ts with Jest unit tests covering KnexLeaveRepository: findById, findAll, create, update, delete (inherited from BaseKnexRepository), plus findByEmployeeId, findByStatus, findOverlapping (including overlap detection with SUBMITTED/APPROVED statuses and excludeId), and updateStatus.
All repository methods must surface errors as domain error types (NotFoundError, ValidationError, ConflictError) from src/shared/error.types.ts where appropriate, per GP-006.

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer (GP-001). KnexLeaveRepository extends BaseKnexRepository<T> from src/shared/base.repository.ts.

All id fields are string type (UUIDs). Date fields use Date type. Nullable fields (approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, cancellationReason) are string|null or Date|null.

Table name is 'leave_requests'. Column names follow snake_case mapping: leaveTypeId → leave_type_id, employeeId → employee_id, etc. The KnexLeaveRepository constructor accepts knex: Knex and tableName: string (defaulting to 'leave_requests').
No circular dependencies. The leave module in this phase depends only on src/shared/base.repository.ts and src/shared/error.types.ts (Phase 1).
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks. Use unknown with type guards instead of any (constraint no-any).
Test framework is Jest. Tests go in tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.repository.test.ts. Repository tests must mock Knex instance — no real database connection.
outOfScope: Service layer (leave.service.interface.ts, leave.service.ts) — deferred to Phase 3.
Routes and module registration (leave.routes.ts, index.ts, app.ts update) — deferred to Phase 5/8.
Database migrations and seeds — deferred to Phase 6.
LeaveType and LeavePolicy repositories — only LeaveRequest repository is in scope for this phase.
RBAC enforcement, audit logging (GP-002), input validation at API boundaries (GP-003) — these are service/controller concerns deferred to later phases.
